**For:** a reader of the agent index tests.

**What it does:** this page lists two codes. Each code has an anchor.

## Before you start

- Read the [start page](/docs/start/) first.

## The codes

<h3 id="invalid_body"><code>invalid_body</code> 400</h3>

The body is not valid JSON. See the <abbr title="specification">spec</abbr> at <https://example.com/spec>.

<h3 id="unauthorized"><code>unauthorized</code> 401</h3>

The request has no session.<br />Sign in again.
